lines.text: That knot in your stomach? God already knows about it. Isaiah forty-one, ten.
Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God:
I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee.
The problem might be big. The One standing next to you is bigger.
Lord, steady us today. Amen. I'm Derrick Hughes. Have a blessed day.
